name: fold
desc_en: The window opens on the photograph folded on its own centre line, the mountain and the car window mirrored into perfect symmetry; then the seam gives way and the real half unfolds to take the whole window.
desc_zh: 視窗一開是照片沿中線對摺的樣子，山與車窗鏡像成完全對稱；接著中縫鬆開，真正的那一半展開佔滿整個視窗。
borrowed: The fold from the Dark main title: a real picture mirrored on its own vertical centre line so it reads as strangely symmetrical, here made only from his photograph and resolved by the seam unfolding into the true image.
